title: appointments.appointments.create
description: An appointment is booked against REAL records (appointments#21): the customer, the service and the professional are LINKS to the customers/services/staff modules, not free text. Since appointments#11 the SNAPSHOT (customer name/phone/email, service name/price/duration, professional name) is FROZEN by the handler from the rows the runtime pre-loads through `reads` (customers.get, services.services.get, staff.members.get, staff.services.eligible_for_service); the denormalized fields below are accepted for compatibility with older callers and IGNORED — the browser does not decide who the customer is, what the service costs or who performs it.

customer_name.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

customer_phone.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

customer_email.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

service_name.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

service_price.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

staff_name.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the snapshot comes from the authoritative read.

duration_minutes.description: Optional. When omitted, the professional's override, else the service's catalogue duration, else the module default applies.

settings.description: Lectura aportada por el caller (fila de appointments.settings.get): el runtime no precarga lecturas para el handler WASM; el guest usa allow_overlapping/default_duration de aquí.

existing_appointments.description: Fallback de citas candidatas a solape (de appointments.appointments.list del día) si el runtime NO precargó la read autoritativa. Desde appointments#110 el comando `create` declara `reads` sobre `appointments.appointments.conflicting`, que el runtime inyecta en `context.reads` y el handler prioriza por encima de este campo.

service.description: Ignored since appointments#11 (kept for older callers): the service row comes from the `services.services.get` read.
